purpose: Track genomic controls, denominator-scope caveats, and diversity/portability infrastructures.
calibration_move: rev0020 adds HLA-B*15:02/carbamazepine and PCSK9 controls plus portability/diversity audit records; the cube should learn scoped generalization rather than cynicism or naive universality.

axis_hypotheses.hypothesis: Alcohol flushing and drug hypersensitivity are tighter phenotypes than broad psychiatric outcomes.
Enzyme-pathway and HLA drug-hypersensitivity relations may have stronger mechanistic/effect-size signals than diffuse common-trait candidates.
A robust association is not the same as implementable clinical guidance; CPIC/PharmGKB/ClinGen-like rails matter.
Population/ancestry scope is not a footnote; it is part of the evidence object.
A real association or useful score still needs evidence that it travels from training/discovery denominator to target population and context.
Denominator repair includes who governs research, who has access, and who can set questions, not only who is sampled.
